en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone must have gone to the hangar
already... I shouldn't be late.

...Kokichi hasn't noticed us yet.
Come, let's begin.
Hurry, Shuichi!

I-It's the climactic final battle!
Time to show off my magic!

Don't be slow! If you're young, 
you need to move quickly!

...You're late. We were about to start
without you.

What are you waiting for!? Hurry up and
hit the panel with the Electrohammer!

Did you see the three Exisals on the way?
They weren't moving for some reason...

Anyway, there are two more of them 
inside this hangar, so let's be careful.

Shuichi, hurry! We need to disable 
the barrier before we can go inside!

<CLT=cltMIND>I'll deal with the Exisals later.
For now, I need to keep moving.

There's no time for that!
Hit the control panel, please!

For now, I need to keep moving.

There's no time for that!
Hit the control panel, please!

For now, I need to keep moving.

Hit the control panel, please!

<CLT=cltMIND>I'll deal with the Exisals later.
For now, I need to keep moving.

There's no time for that!
Hit the control panel, please!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone must have gone to the hangar
already... I shouldn't be late.

Shuichi, where are you going!?
We don't have time, y'know!?

huh?
Is this...an Electrohammer?
<CLT=cltMIND>Why is there an Electrohammer here?

<CLT=cltMIND>...No, details later.
I need to keep moving.

<CLT=cltMIND>This Electrohammer is disconcerting...
but I need to keep moving.

What are you doing, Shuichi?
We need to save Kaito!

<CLT=cltMIND>It's dangerous to call for Kaito now.
This will all be for naught if Kokichi finds us.
Hurry, Shuichi! Or else, Kokichi will notice us!

Alright...
If I hit the control panel with this...

<CLT=cltMIND>As I swung up the Electrohammer,
I suddenly noticed...

<CLT=cltMIND>The control panel was covered in marks,
as if damaged by something sharp...
Shuichi, what are you doing? Hurry up.
S-Sorry. I've got it!
<CLT=cltMIND>No time to think now.

<CLT=cltMIND>I aimed my swing at the control panel
and brought it down as hard as I could.
The electric barrier turned off!
Let's go!
<CLT=cltMIND>We all ran to the shutter at once.

We won't let Kokichi do whatever 
he wants anymore!
You'd better be ready! This is it!
The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnants of Despair<CLT=typeNORMAL> end here and now!

<CLT=cltMIND>After opening the shutter, we burst
into the hangar, Electrohammers in hand...
<CLT=cltMIND>...to end this.
<CLT=cltMIND>To end this killing game.
<CLT=cltMIND>To end this despair—

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone must have gone to the hangar
already... I shouldn't be late.

Shuichi, where are you going!?
We don't have time, y'know!?
Hurry, hit the panel!
Everyone is here. Let's get started right away.
I-I'm ready!

Maki, are you ready with the
Electrobomb?
...Who do you think you're talking to?

It's similar to a grenade, except the detonation
lags a bit after you push the switch.

Once we roll this to the front of the shutter,
it should disable the alarm system.
...This won't fail.

The Electrobomb has an effective range of
50 yards, and lasts for two hours...

If Kokichi's remote control is disabled, we'll
stand a chance against the Exisals.

Let's stop Kokichi before he
gets into the Exisal.

But be ready for the worst.
We might have to use the Electrohammers.

If he gets into that Exisal...
I'll stop him with this hammer.
Yeah, you're right...

What's wrong, Maki Roll? We're...all ready
to start, y'know?
...Yeah, alright.
Then...let's go.

<CLT=cltMIND>Maki triggered the Electrobomb,
then rolled it in front of the shutter.
<CLT=cltMIND>And then...

The alarm system is disabled! Now we can
approach the control panel!
...Shuichi, will you do the honors!?
Alright, leave it to me!

Shuichi, where are you going!?
We don't have time, y'know!?
Huh?

<CLT=cltMIND>Monokuma's...not here...
He should have been protected by the Exisals.
<CLT=cltMIND>And...the Exisals...

<CLT=cltMIND>They don't look like they're going to
move... What's going on?
<CLT=cltMIND>And there are only three of them.
<CLT=cltMIND>There should be two more in the hangar...

It's just like Keebo said... We should consider
ourselves lucky that there's only two.

<CLT=cltMIND>If all five of them are here, it'd be
impossible to execute the plan.
Alright...let's keep moving.
